note: Finals pass (SPEC 6.4: stage 1 -> x2 latent upscale -> crop). A planned upscale job carries the plate's resolved parameters and this map declares where each lands, with the stage-2 controls (its own noise seed and the short sigma schedule) named explicitly. Geometry follows the same rule as the plate map (GPU test 2, issues 3 and 4): the planned size is the *final* size, so the stage-1 latent (8) and the i2v image scale (31) both take half of it - half of the upscale target is the plate's final size, which the x2 upsampler (21) then doubles. The upsampler node itself takes no scalar input; the crop that brings the result back to the package format lives on the job (dims/upscaleTarget/crop) and is applied by the renderer, not by the graph. A package that names gen.inputs.upscale_workflow gets that graph's own map instead - which is why the map has a name of its own. The start image is a local file the runner uploads ('files'). R1: 'strength' maps the stage-1 LTXVImgToVideoInplace (33) and 'stage2_strength' the stage-2 one (34), so a plan can hold a static frame (UI/diagram plates take strength 1.0; the graph's own default is 0.7).
